 Garden Hoe will now trigger on all building drafts, not just population drafts.
 Holt’s Observatory effect “+ 1 Spare time” changed from “at start of loop” to “at start of every island”.
 Holt’s Hero Statue effect changed from “start of loop” to “start of every island”.
Sibyl’s third kinship modified to make it easier : “Meet Sibyl with at least 3 combined feathers, beaks or talons”.
 Housing Hall’s last upgrade Eitr income increased from 3 to 5.
 Housing Hall’s range increased by about 10%.
 Runic Forge event now has a cap of 100 Matter when trading.


Performance 🔨

 Improved performances in Nidavellir biome.
 Upgraded Unity version to take advantage of many small graphical performance fixes.

Note : Thanks to those who confirmed the improvements from last patch! If you still have performance issues, let us know on Discord or in the Steam Discussions :)


Quality of Life 💎 

 Previews of upgraded cards will now also show keywords that were added on the card.
 Previews of upgraded cards will now also show the proper amount of uses if amount of uses on original card was modified by events.

 Artifacts
Fixed Munnin’s Wiseness and Huggin’s Thougts appeareance rate being too low.

 Buildings & Artifacts

notes.title: Update 1.1 - QoL + Performance Fixes
notes.content:
Update 1.1
Thanks to everyone for playing! We're enjoying watching you play and listening to your feedback! 

This first patch is a direct response to your feedback from this weekend. It includes some bugfixes, improved performance and quality of life changes. Let's jump into it!

Balance 📝

 Eitr Enhancer changed from common to uncommon.
 Eitr Transformer changed from common to uncommon.
 Stone Purifier changed from uncommon to common. Gained Eitr changed from 30 to 25.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/86f442e3506b349714a3fb828376a707746834ca.png
 Matter obtained for each cleared island increased from 20 to 30.
 You can now skip artifact choices from some events and from Njord.


Performance 🔨

 Improved Performance on lower end systems. (Thanks MeanRev for helping to test this!)
 Reduced Graphic Memory usage. 
 Added Texture Quality Settings. If you’re struggling with performance with the new patch, try lowering the texture quality.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/db500b37e235bec11f74d596eb8a8622fbf24c9d.png

Note : We've fixed all the isssues we could reproduce, but If you still have crashes or performance issues with this new build, please post below your computer specs and information about the problems you're encountering! Thanks!


Quality of Life ✨ 
 Tweaked placement conditions for Fishing Traps, they will now be easier to place.
 Added the time since last save in the warning message when leaving the game.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/f5e4292ca209f385b5574ca561c5554bf9c63bcd.png



Bug Fixes 🐛

 Progression
Fixed an issue in tutorial which would let you unlock Workshop too early, resulting in a softlock.
 Fixed issue where added keywords on cards would not be properly reloaded when leaving the game.
 Maximalist achievement not counts housing and Observatory when counting the amount of cards in the deck.
 Buildings & Artifacts
 Holt’s Lumbermill requirement fixed. No longer require 10 Trees!
 Sprouting Hut and Unearther will now work in tutorial.
 Fixed Talon items not working on the following island when acquired during travel.
 Fixed “Complete 50 Adventures with Kare” milestone not counting properly.
 Localization
Fixed many spelling mistakes in the french localization (Thank you Nanashi!)


Reviews
Reviews are quite important for Steam Discoverability, especially close to release. If you enjoy the game and haven't left one yet, please consider doing so, it helps us tremendously :)

As always, If you have feedback for us, we're reading the Discord and the Steam Forums!

notes.title: Update 1.0 : Valkyrie's Lament
notes.content:
Introduction
Welcome to Roots of Yggdrasil 1.0!

This update contains new characters, buildings and over 100+ Changes and improvements! Over the course of Early Access, we've used your feedback to shape the game. We've added and reworked a lot of systems, but until now, most of the quests, characters and collection was left incomplete. This changes now as we tie up those loose ends today! We are very excited to bring you this massive update. Hope you enjoy it 🤗 

[previewyoutube=y96K5yRfNWM;full][/previewyoutube]

Before we go in-depth, here's is a quick recap of some of the biggest features added in this update.

 New Scion : The Valkyrie
 New Housing : Hall Houses
 New Adventures & Map events
 New Artifacts & Buildings
 A Conclusion to all the Quests!
 ...And much more!


New Playable Scion : The Valkyrie

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/88c6c16d469ed8957305742a1a7c8ae0fc88cb20.png
Eir, our new Playable scion, is centered on Threats. It’s all about taking risks, creating danger in order to exploit it. Let’s look at her starting passives :

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/db0564176f0df436a1df7eba92989828d549c921.png

War Cry gives might income per turn every time a Threat spawns. This helps dealing with most of them, which will trigger its second passive, gaining population when you spend might. With this, you can now see why spawning threats is interesting for Eir. This is why her active ability, Cursed Valkyrie, simply spawns a Threat on the map. But be careful, it could be a draugr camp, a storm or even a fire!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/68c7f2eb12332f24ddd3be3ed39a46c99ee987de.gif

New Housing : Halls 
New Housing Type available : Great Halls and Hall Houses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/9ce9e5d75852aeb7d05e4eea405a4ea91c0feeca.png

Great halls are expansive buildings that can be upgraded when placing housing near them. Hall houses are cheap, but do not give anything by themselves. Place them near Great Halls to obtain population. Each upgrade of the Great Hall gives an income of a different resource, so place your housing carefully!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/31e880831786d28980e2350e2cce779b9660632b.gif


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/181f3c3685ac0849a27ac3e0216fa724ec5a576e.png
Buildings 🏭
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/c739c03176722aa089450b6075417770ca8d71ae.png
Developer Notes:  With this update we're bringing many more deckbuilding options. Raiding camp allows you to keep threats around for a bonus if you can manage them. Lodging upgrade opens all kinds of possibilities with each housing type. Cart maker brings a new mechanic to the game by creating a zone around it that will allow you to draw cards when building in it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0a6fe90c94f1c9ad846de9c88d9cc69113c25c9c.png
Developer Notes: We also added more options to play with Eitr with the Eitr Transformer and Enhancers. This new guild will also work well with Eir's new powers focused on Threats. 

Artifacts 💍
You'll find new artifacts both in the default pool and some to unlock in the Greenhouse this patch. Take a look at some of them : 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/9bdc859203450efd66e8b6eeeecded7839d12e30.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b4c1b9714223aa753ae5582256fe8307ada85775.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/366e3c780b0c255283aa2ff687098a7bfc442dba.png

Developer Notes:  This time again, our goal with artifacts is to allow new playstyles. Use Living Brick to reduce the cost of your buildings and draft more. Skip those drafts to upgrade your deck using Verdant Hoe or draft ephemeral cards to benefit from the bonus of Mead of Poetry when they leave your deck. 

There's some other artifacts as well, but we'll let you discover them yourselves!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/669d392ab45f347c7d7c39770239b840d5a69a9a.png

Events & Adventures
 New Warden : Gerda
    
     The Last Jotun joins the adventure! Explore Asgard to meet our new warden. Gerda has her own story and events for you to discover!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/043e5df60e20a9bdd1cde90c947e60c78548889c.png
 3 New Adventures
    
     Runic Forge : Transform your resources from a type to another!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/d0ab0ae3fe18ed68f2d82c1a44dc7c416ad09d16.png
     Runic Stone : Add a keyword to a card.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7a5075b0db753b9b9c1df607def06891973eff74.png
     Runic Altar : Gain a Brittle Action card.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/6c5a37e2e4f5b40061621f023926b08075551360.png
 Improved Wardens :
    
     When reaching 2 Kinships with Sibyl, Njord, Vidarr and Gerda, they will now appear in special events during Travel.
      When maxing Kinships with Sibyl, Njord, Vidarr and Gerda, they will unlock a Holt building which improve their powers.
 Added 5 new random Timeline Events to more than double the variety of events.
 Added new negative keywords that can be added to cards :
     {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b85cec088e7d418df4483c4055bab1964af0ce96.png
Developer Notes:  Card keywords are something we've been wanting to add for a while. This time however, we're adding negative keywords! Some trials and events will add them to cards in your deck, forcing you to think carefully about deckbuilding and the order of played cards!



Trials

 Trials now apply a multiplier on total meta resources obtained in loop. Be daring, receive more loot! 
 Added New Trials
  Weakened 1/2/3 : Increase Housing Building cost by 2/4/6 supplies.
  Cursed : Add negative keywords to cards
   Cursed 1 : Add Burden to a card.
   Cursed 2 : Add Frail to a card.
   Cursed 3 : Add Haunted to a card. Added New Difficulty Levels
    Increased level cap of scion and housing from 5 to 10.
    Increased amount of active trials needed to level changed from 1/2/3/4/5 to 1/3/5/7/10/13/16/20/25/30 Leveling Scions and Housing now gives matter and blueprints rewards.
  Improved feedback on the levels of Scion and Housing in Expedition Screen. You can now see your current trial level, active trials, your supply multiplier and  the requirements to level up for scions and housing.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b15355cf05d245530ed5f4e88e2ca76760b30a0b.png
Balance 📝
Trials🌞
 Maxing a Trial now gives an extra trial point.
 Lethargy has a new level : Population required to draft new cards increased from 1/2 to 1/2/3.
 Bad Draugr has a new level : Draugr's range increased from 50%/150% to 50%/100%/150%.
Hard To Crack has two new levels : Sapling requirements increased from 25%/50% to 25%/50%/75%/100%.

Artifacts & Powers🔨
 Sap Stained Goblet cannot be stacked anymore.
 Thrasir's Early Bird changed from "Buildings cost 50% less for 5 turns" to "Buildings cost 50% less for 3 turns".
 Shattered Shackles improved from "Draw 1 card when skipping a turn without playing" to "Draw 3 cards when skipping a turn without playing".

Events🌟
 Improved Odds of the “Game of Chance” from 50%/50%/50% to 60%/65%/70%.

Buildings🏡
 Increased Field Supply Income from 8 to 15.
 Decreased Iron Extractor's Supply per iron from 45 to 40.
     Removed Iron Extractor's Might Gain. Increased Iron Mine's Supply Income from 5 to 8.
 Increased Iron Dig's Supply Income from 5 to 6
     Iron Dig+ iron limit increased from 1 to 2. Increased Gathering Post's Supply Income from 2 to 8.
 Increased Logger's Camp' Supply Income from 3 to 5.
     Logger's Camp+ tree limit increased from 3 to 5. Increased Lumber Yard's Supply Income from 3/5 to 5/8.
     Lumber Yard no longer destroys trees. Increased Warehouse's Supply per card from 40 to 50.
 Increased Campfire's Pop gain from 1 to 2.
 Increased Blacksmith's Supply Income from 20 to 30.
 Increased Market's Supply Income from 40 to 50.
 Bow Maker now also gives 20/30 Might when placed.
 Increased Iron Enhancer Supply income per iron from 3 to 5.
 Increased Tree Enhancer Supply income per tree from 2 to 3.
 Increased Worker's Guild Supply gain from 20/30 to 40/60.
 Increased Stone Purifier's Eitr gain from 20 to 30.
 Increased Port's adventure Supply reward from 50 to 100.
 Added Exhaust keyword to all Enhancer buildings.
     Enhancer+ buildings removed Exhaust.

Quality Of Life📜

 You can now reset your save in the options menu if you want to start fresh.
 Obtained resources will now appear on screen from the artifact/building it was gained from.
 Added “Borderless Window” option in the screen settings.
 Improved colliders of buildings to improve placement.
 When rotating the camera or a building, mouse will not be contained by the screen anymore.
 Slight Performance improvements on Boot.
 Fixed Graphical issues with shadows
 Added Feedback when earning meta currencies
 Added Feedback when adding a card to deck or exhaust pile.
 Most events now have a small delay between their animation and a window offering a choice to player. This makes the flow of events clearer.
 Increased the compendium's text size for most elements.

Other Improvements 🎨
 Nidavellir and Asgard’s doors have been improved.
 Sibyl’s housing has been improved.
 Improved Debris and Hexes sides in the Holt.
Holt Buildings 🏭

 Removed Holt Campfire's Amenity tag.
 Removed Holt Iron Dig's effect, added Amenity tag.
 Removed Holt Logger's Camp effect, increased tree requirement from 2 to 3, added Amenity tag.
 Removed Holt Clearcut Mill's Amenity tag.
 Removed Holt Lumber Yard's effect, removed housing requirement, increased tree requirement from 2 to 10, added Amenity tag.
 Removed Holt Iron Mine's effect, removed housing requirement, added Amenity tag.
 Changed Holt Blacksmith's effect from Might cards to Industry cards.
 Changed Holt Ritual Hut's rarity from Rare to Unique, changed requirement from 2 houses to 1 Eitr source.
 Changed Holt Seer's Guild requirements from 2 houses and 1 amenity to 2 amenity.
 Changed Holt Great Hall's requirements from 2 houses and 1 amenity to 2 amenity.
 Changed Holt Scout Camp's requirements from 3 houses and 1 amenity to 2 amenity.
 Changed Holt Treaded Crane's requirements from 2 houses and 2 amenity to 2 amenity.
 Changed Holt Eitr Laboratory's requirements from 2 houses and 2 amenity to 2 amenity.
 Changed Holt Salvager's requirements from 2 houses and 2 amenity to 2 amenity.
 Changed Holt Berserker Camp's requirements from 2 houses and 2 amenity to 2 amenity.
 Changed Holt Watchtower's requirements from 2 houses and 2 amenity to 2 amenity, changed rarity from Uncommon to Rare.
 Changed Holt Rune Carver's requirements from 2 houses and 1 tree to 1 house and 2 trees.
 Changed Holt Training Ground's requirements from 3 houses to 1 house, changed rarity from Uncommon to Common, removed Amenity tag.
 Changed Holt Homestead's requirements from 2 amenity to 1 amenity.
 Changed Holt Unearther's requirements from 2 iron and 2 houses to 2 iron and 1 house.
 Changed Holt Sprouting Hut's requirements from 2 trees and 2 houses to 3 trees and 1 house.
 Changed Holt Armory's requirements from 1 house and 1 amenity to 1 amenity.
 Changed Holt Caravan's requirements from 1 house and 1 Eitr source to 1 Eitr source.
 Changed Holt Market's rarity from Common to Uncommon, removed amenity tag.
 Changed Holt Eitr Prospector's rarity from Common to Uncommon, removed amenity tag.
 Changed Holt Blacksmith's rarity from Common to Uncommon, removed amenity tag.
 Changed Holt Bowmaker's rarity from Common to Uncommon, removed amenity tag.
 Changed Holt Wood Gatherer's requirements from 3 houses and 1 tree to 2 houses and 1 tree.

Developer Notes: The many changes to the Holt Buildings aim to make it easier to place them. More of them are now amenities and their requirements have been reduced a bit. We've also tweaked the buildings using trees and rocks so they can provide amenities while requiring less housing. We hope this change make the Holt progression much smoother!

The buildings already placed in your save will stay there even if their requirement changed. Make sure to replace them if you want to enjoy their new requirements!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/69c5024841511d09a89bf44ef1af502f21d55e84.png

Holt Buildings Packs 🃏

 Building pack odds improved to 2 common, 1 common/uncommon building and 2 common resources.
  Building pack blueprint cost increased from 3 to 5.
  Premium pack odds improved to 3 common, 1 uncommon, 1 Rare buildings with chances to improve each to higher tiers.
  Decorative pack odds improved to 2 common resources + 1 common, 1 uncommon and 1 rare cosmetic with chances to improve each to higher tiers.



Bug Fixes 🐛

 Progression
Added rewards to every milestones.
 Fixed some milestones not being revealed at the same time as Kare.
 Fixed some quests not progressing.
 Artifacts & Modifiers
 Fixed description of many artifacts containing extra characters.
 Fixed French localization of some artifacts.
 Improved description of trials.
 Fixed Many milestones not progressing properly.

 Controls
Fixed Invert Camera setting not working in Holt.
Fixed Mouse being bound to screen when rotating a building.
Fixed Mouse not reacting properly on edge of screen when in windowed mode.
Fixed Weird interaction with pause when placing a building or hovering an activatable.

 Buildings
 Fixed Drakkar placement preventing it to be placed on some rivers.
 Fixed Drakkar placement sometimes allowing itself to be placed on land tiles next to rivers.
 Fixed Holt Building Treaded Crane and Watchtower that did not reload properly after a loop.
 Improved Enhancer's wording and feedbacks to make them clearer.
 Fixed Rally sometimes spawning a floating caravan.
 Fixed Arms Factory not giving the proper amount of Might.

 Maps
 Fixed some Midgard maps having areas where placement was impossible
 Fixed Disappearing sapling when multiple exploration lead to the same tiles in Vanaheim and Midgard.
 Fixed an hex in Nidavellir having invisible collisions, preventing placement.
 Improved collisions of Warden’s buildings.
 Improved Collisions of Asgard’s Bridges.
 Fixed Collisions of adventures buildings (Caravan, Mines, Kare's house, etc).
 Fixed Flourish not working in Nidavellir.

 Other
 Fixed Issue with the Norn event in each loop containing the same choice.
 Fixed Rarity of drafts sometimes being too high at the end of a loop.
 Fixed Objectives window's progress bar not working for Saplings Objectives.
 Fixed Exploited resources staying exploited when the exploiting building is destroyed.
 When in Holt building mode, other activatable will now be hidden until leaving the building mode.



THANK YOU!
From everyone at Manavoid, Thank you for your support! It's been a great journey to bring this game to its full release and we're very excited to see your attempts to reach the top of Yggdrasil!

If you have feedback for us or if you manage to reach level 10 trials, reach out to us on Discord or on the Steam Forums! Good luck everyone!

notes.title: 1.0 Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
🚀The 1.0 Release Date 🚀
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/341a1b4a584cdd363ff44c02422b30141ca19a88.png
 What's in it? 
It's official, Roots of Yggdrasil releases in 1.0 Soon! But what's in this new update?
We had planned another patch before releasing 1.0, but as we worked on it, we realized bundling all the changes together made way more sense. That means the next patch is going to be BIG. Let's take a a quick look at some of the changes.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/181f3c3685ac0849a27ac3e0216fa724ec5a576e.png
New Events
We are adding more variety in the events you'll encounter in each biome. You'll meet new characters that offer strong boons to help you overcome the challenging trials ahead.

Sneak Peek: You'll sometimes find Runic Stones, which can be used to add keywords on a card in your deck. These allow you to customize your deck further and create stronger synergies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/cc6aede8328e4fe1949772308fc5bfdb049bab99.gif

New Cards & Artifacts
We've added new cards to play with too! This time, we're also focusing on opening new build opportunities with new mechanics. We won't spoil too much now since there's a many some new mechanics that are introduced. 

Sneak Peek: Here's a new common, uncommon and rare building cards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7f000f0d114ad99ad6cc0d2964711803d5d6aeb4.png

New Scion and Housing
This patch will contain our fourth playable scion and housing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/a15bda11d2cb1d10c9cae5ce6c7038f4667ae14f.png
We won't talk about them yet, but like other scions, this new character comes with a full story and quest! We'll let you discover how to unlock them!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b15355cf05d245530ed5f4e88e2ca76760b30a0b.png
Character's Quests and Storylines
We've added the end of every character quest in the game, including a unique reward for each of them. You'll want to make some place in your Holt to enjoy some of the new powers!

Reworked Expedition Screen
We've made many improvements to the UI when preparing for an expedition. You'll now find a much clearer explanation of the strengths of each Scion.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/469fed0b365df952e3c471f6e24db5a0561ecbc5.gif

Reworked Trials
When choosing Trials, you'll have an easy way to see if your Scion or housing will level up if you succeed. In addition, your trial level now adds a multiplier on matter acquired during loops!

A BIG thank you to all of our community and our development team! We're excited to share the full version of Roots of Yggdrasil  with you. notes.title: Update 4 : Home Sweet Holt 🚧
notes.content:

This update brings big changes to meta progression. Here's an overview of the content : 

 Holt Overhaul
 Over 50 New Holt Buildings
 4 New Artifacts
 5 New Building Cards

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/fa69e90458fbacf046fac7ba1e7d9e0b28e840ee.png


Holt Refactor
Ratatoskr is in a renovating mood! The first thing you notice when landing at the new Holt is that your precious buildings have been dismantled. But fear not! Invested resources have been refunded!

Our goal with this update was to redesign the meta systems of the Holt in order to create a strong foundation for long term progression. It also allowed to rebalance the holt buildings while adding a LOT of variety in the effects. This should allow for more build expression in the builds you create.

The Workshop🃏
Holt buildings are now acquired different building packs in the Workshop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b4767b4711c3dc5324a3b336a9a75e6c750cf34a.png

 Building Packs allow you to spend blueprints to unlock new holt buildings. These buildings come in four different rarities. Spend more blueprints on the premium pack for a bigger chance of rare buildings!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/df07499ba6610a93cb779ea00b0c64232a97da86.gif
 Cosmetic Pack allow you to obtain resources and cosmetic resources to place in the Holt. The perfect way to customize your holt!
 Housing pack cost matter and allow you to increase your housing cap. Each building with a positive effect will require a nearby housing so increasing your housing cap is a good indicator of your Holt's progression!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/285c6550d8ad67b48b98e01a1dc13348699f15cc.gif


Placement Mode 🔨

 Holt buildings are now placed through a shiny new placement mode rather than through the workshop.
 Holt Buildings available are displayed as a hand of cards like they are in a loop.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/ebfeead462f44a03b99752c9168f4013848cb241.gif
 Holt buildings can now be removed anytime through the Dismantle card available in the placement mode, as long as that building isn’t currently being exploited. Dismantling a building refunds its full cost in materials to your inventory and returns its card to your hand, allowing you to place it elsewhere.
 The Buildings tab in the Workshop now lists all Holt buildings available in the game. Get out there and collect them all!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b749709e9abaaeeb700162e85257b26f56152b42.gif


Improvements ✨

 The Holt received a visual upgrade, including lighting and VFX improvements!
 The renovations have left a big mess in the Holt! Use Matter to clear a path and unlock new building zones.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0da300b7a993383c0fc227d9680288c2faf39eb1.gif
 Running out of building space? The Holt can be expanded further in the Greenhouse!

New Cards
Refiners🏭
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/d0d519a6e38fb9393aa2792dbf696be05af89e7f.png

Might 🔪
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/95d5ae06534fb594817466db12a84ff313906e23.png

Developer Notes:  While there's already a few reliable options to generate might, we think adding more of them will allow you to create builds where the cards that generate might combo with other effects in your builds.

Amenity🍺
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/4d69ee065e23e9169025c05558c798d02d1348f0.png

Developer Notes:  This one should give a little more options for cards with exhaust. It also gives another way to spend Eitr if you're looking in creating combos with exhaust cards.

Artifacts 💍
This update we bring you a set of artifacts that plays around time. Take a look!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/4764e585b6db68504dc41466ec20f2b79d718137.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/507b296b163c3d67107e595c893819a99200d14a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/851a9d1732ec4fdc45e07c4770b965bcaa8586d3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/4ad5b706c2ccf8de5c01ddc2c0c34be583f6c176.png

Developer Notes:  With these artifacts, we want to give more possibilities to play with time. The Mane artifacts allow you to sacrifice turns for improved income, while the others capitalize on spending more time at night.

Balance 📝

 “Fire” Threat’s amount of turns before destroying buildings has been increased (3 → 4)
 Existing Holt buildings have had their effects and requirements rebalanced.
 Increases the amount of Matter obtained at the end of an island : 
    
     For Fully explored maps : 0 → 10
     For Threats removed : 1 → 2
     For Caves and Shipwrecks completed : 0 → 2
    
 Increased the amount of Blueprints obtained at the end of an island. The first island gives 1 and that value increase for each subsequent upgrade.
 Improved Procedural generation when calculating objectives to put on map. Short term, this should make it so less similar objectives appear on the map. Long term, this will allow us to diversify the kinds of adventures that happen in a single loop.
 Rebalanced most existing effects of Holt Buildings.
 Keywords on Action cards have been standardized so cards with Brittle always have Retain.


Bug Fixes 🐛
 Fixed Unlock conditions for many character’s Kinships.
 Fixed Unlock conditions for many Milestones.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7ee4ff02a1d8d85d69ea759b5a54b1c0dcde71c1.gif
 Fixed Issues with Azerty layout.
 Fixed mouse being confined in windowed mode.
 Fixed calculation of some artifacts being calculated twice.
 Fixed warehouse calculating initial draw for its effect.
 Fixed issues with selection of cards when using shortcuts.


Quality of Life 😇
 Improved sorting of cards in hands Compendium and hands.
 Improved tracking of milestones.
 Added Many Milestones for Kinships of Scions and Wardens to help tracking of objectives.
 Main menu was reworked and cleaned!
 Improved card draw/discard animations.
 The list of Holt effects is now much clearer than before!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/218b95344e46010ac5217abd1bdf094357d1cf94.png



It's LIVE! 🔥
Did we mention the game is 25% off to celebrate the release of the Update? 
Consider sharing it with your friends before the game's priced is increased once the full release of 1.0!

We're excited to know what you think of the new Holt system! Hop on Discord or the Steam forums to share your Holt and your feedback about the new system. See you soon for another news!

notes.content:
Kare joins the adventure!
[previewyoutube=RvAdciaG_4w;full][/previewyoutube]
Meet the Skald, a new playable scion expert in card manipulation and adventuring. With every update we try to add a new playstyle into the game. This time, it's all about drawing and upgrading your deck!

New System : Milestones
Kare brings with him a whole new progression & Objectives system. As you play, he will record your adventure and unlock rewards when specific goals have been achieved :

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/56816846fab298851046413e97532e317b272748.gif

 A new page in the Compendium.
 Over 50 Milestones

5 New Buildings

 Outpost : Draw 1, Gain 5 Might, gain a Temporary Outpost building (Ephemeral, Draw 1, Gain 5 Might).
 Trader's Guild : Gain 5 supplies for each Card in your deck.
 Warehouse : Gain 40 supplies for each additional Card drawn this turn.
 Seer's Guild : Gain 20 supplies for each Action card in your deck.
 Ritual hut : Gain an Action card draft, gain a Curse card.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7d3bbda1b8550089c745144a249c67e5e664dc46.png

5 New Action Cards
A mysterious figure has appeared in Nidavellir! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0e588eba5aa1fd27f6f3ecdc9a09b890339d3eeb.png
This new encounter will allow you to obtain a new type of action cards with the Swift keyword. These are all strong additions to a deck that will give you a lot of flexibility to be more creative in deckbuilding.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/39c00e5c4e2a3be20a589d8182b6203a97f0d10b.png

New Content : Maps
A new Nidavellir map has been added. This is where you'll meet the new characters!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/a80451320dec318a378c5f0e53eedd6b3264bead.gif

New Content : Modifiers
5 New Artifacts
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/56f42b7f1d826bf90eff607b51a4288a903f5e1a.png
10 MORE new Artifacts?!
We fixed an issue that made the unlockable Artifacts from the Greenhouse not appear in choices. This mean these 10 artifacts are also being added in this update!

Balance

 Shattered Shackles now gives 2 cards instead of 1 when not playing a card during a turn.
 Observatory cost now keep increasing past 100 Eitr. We’ve seen your crazy builds!
 Caravan events that can give Acorns and Blueprints can now happen only once per map.
 Seedlings with area of effect objectives will now have an increased radius when modified by a trial.
 Rune Carver requirements changed to improve flexibility.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7f97c82ffaba0468c3b3c61372aa6862307411b5.png


Controls

 PController support update :

 Controller support has been greatly expanded! For this update, we mainly focused on controllers that include touchpads, notably Steam Deck, DualSense and DualShock 4 gamepads.
 The camera controls have been finetuned for a much snappier experience when navigating with analog sticks.
 Common game actions have been mapped to the gamepad, including navigating through your hand, cycling between map objectives, cycling through notifications.
 Most in-game popup windows should now react to standard gamepad navigation, without requiring explicit mouse input.

 Added AZERTY Keyboard layout support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/5c95038b4b8257221d58d6a12fc74f1dc9548896.png
 Camera controls are now smoother and snappier.


Graphics

 Notifications now come with a bit of extra flair!
 Kare moved in and made the Compendium a little more cozy.
 Improved ground “wiggles” quality that give a better hand-drawn look.
 Main menu buttons got a small upgrade.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0fb33ec97ecd6fa18dcded016d496f1556ed7846.gif
 Increased diversity of props in environment
 Stairs should now be a lot more visible to help indicate when a path is available.
 Changes in the rendering of clouds should make them cleaner.
 Updated some icons in the end game screen
 Fixed Construct card having the wrong art in draft screen.
 Smite now feels much better (with sounds too!)


Bug Fixes
Major Bugs

 Fixed a few Kinships that were unobtainable.
 Fixed a possible soft lock in Travel Screen when an event would be cancelled by using the escape key.
 Fixed a possible soft lock that happened when skipping some events.
 It’s now possible to click through a storm to activate an exploration tile.
 Fixed Spade of Vigor counting all population earned instead of just the current one.
 Fixed error in Lif’s Passives calculations which ended up giving twice as much income as it should!

Minor Bugs

 Fixed Holt Conversations Repeating when restarting the game.
 Fixed Draft sometimes giving you the same building twice.
 Fixed Instances where notifications of completed events would stay on screen.
 Map negative effects are now properly removed at the end of a map even if they have time remaining.
 Fixed notifications icons sometimes missing in the Holt when returning from a loop.

Text and Localization

 Fixed descriptions of artifacts in compendium sometimes not being accurate.
 Fixed headers in settings that were not localized.



That's All
It's by far our biggest update so far. Since we added a lot of content, let us know how you feel about the balance on the Steam Forums or on Discord. The next update (Update 3) will focus on adding more content rather than new systems. We're working hard on Update 4 in parallel where we'll tackle another big system : The Holt!

We'll keep you up to date on future updates later, it's time to Reach the top of Yggdrasil with Kare now!

We also notice a lot of you found the game too easy. We took that opportunity to prepare an interesting update on the game's difficulty. This time, we've played a lot with the timeline and the population mechanics. Let's take a look!

Update is now live for everyone! - February 8 
[strike]Preview Branch
The patch will be available on the Preview Branch for now. As we finish the testing properly throughout the week, it will be made available to everyone. If you want to try it out early, here is the process to go on the Preview Branch :
[olist]
 Go in the game's properties on Steam.
 In the "Betas" tab, enter the code "YggdrasilPreview".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/489d508a8ae4f64790c80d86ebd1a4340a27b60e.png

Adventure changes

This first pass on the Trials aims to make them harder, but we have more changes planned soon!

notes.title: Early Access Launch info - Don't miss this update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We’ve been hard at work on Roots of Yggdrasil in the last few months, and your feedback on our monthly playtests has been INVALUABLE. Today, we have some VERY exciting news to share in this update. So, without further ado… 

ROOTS OF YGGDRASIL WILL LAUNCH ON STEAM EARLY ACCESS ON JANUARY 24TH 2024!!!

While we initially wanted to cross that threshold over the summer, we realized that we needed a bit more time to make sure that the experience would be as engaging, balanced and fun as possible before bringing the game to the public. 

The team at ManaVoid is incredibly excited to finally launch the game, which will also be our first major self-published title! As you may know, self-publishing is a way for indies to keep total creative control, and we’re so glad to be able to do it with Roots of Yggdrasil. 

Here’s a couple of things you can expect at Early Access launch:

- Visual Update : In preparation for the public release, we’ve put a lot of effort into improving the look of the game. One big thing you’ll notice is how each biome feels more unique and alive. Here’s an example of a map in Vanaheim. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/9188ef83eff427f9b78b5354f8df281285b93699.png

- UI Update : Now that the core mechanics of the game are more defined, we’ve also taken time to polish the Interface. We’ve made it smaller, clearer and also more consistent throughout the game. We also added some quality of life improvements into it, like your overall map progress that’s always visible at the top right! Here’s a peek:

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/d481cbddf1528d481dde27bdc415796908b7f304.png

- Content : We’ve been hard at work on adding content for the game. That means more buildings, artifacts, upgrades… and threats! There’s also a new Warden to meet in Nidavellir. Meeting Vidarr will allow you to draft a reusable action card to add to your deck permanently! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/2eee6f5dcd37a623dd4f7725110560eab893a3bc.png

- End Game : The big addition you’ll see at the launch of Early Access are Hoenir’s Trials. These trials will allow you to customize your game, challenge yourself and earn more rewards. They should challenge even the most hardened Scions!


We’ll be sharing a complete roadmap for the first few months of Early Access as soon as we launch in late January! 

Finally, we want to thank you so, SO much for your support. Roots of Yggdrasil is a game we’ve been wanting to make for years, and it wouldn’t have been possible without your help and unwavering hype for the project.

See you in January!

The ManaVoid Team

notes.title: New Demo - Steam Strategy Fest
notes.content:
Welcome to the Strategy Fest
Today we are pleased to present our new demo. It's been a while since our last public demo, but we've been doing a lot of private playtests in the background to gather feedback and improve the game over the past months. That means there's a LOT of new stuff since the last demo. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/ec73b3c97351ad008288ed55e65bc93aec4d135e.png

New Systems
First, let's take a look at the brand new systems that were added since the last demo.

Travel System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/665737bb296904fa5cde47b49e53972f71a672f8.gif
In between levels, choose your path to the next seedbed carefully since your time is limited! Along the way, you'll find familiar faces, unique events and many opportunities to upgrade your loadout!

Threat System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/a5ee9243438112f255960abf3a9f4ce09f1a7e00.gif
As you explore, you'll discover threats that you'll have to deal with. Those threats can take many forms : A Draugr encampment, a storm, overgrowth brambles and more! They each have a different effect and a way to remove them. However, your trusty "Smite" card in the Observatory will always work too!

Deck Management
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/6bafa142468e349e53d2f9eec50a265b44c5508e.gif
We've added deckbuilding to the game! That's right, cards can now be added and removed from the deck. Every turn, cards are discarded and a new hand is drawn. The main way to add cards will be to increase population to draft cards during population rewards! Choose carefully!

Thrasir's Workshop
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/9f0016f07a9877042ef36f280d5356ee38a049ac.png
In Thrasir workshop, you'll be able to add permanent buildings to the Holt. On top of making the best looking island possible, they will also give you permanent bonuses. Neat!

New Content :
Along those new systems came a lot of content for the existing ones. Let's cover the big ones.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/763369f10ef237470cda4b2ad8a3997d24cf6990.gif

 20+ Buildings
 10+ Modifiers
 New Biome : Nidavellir
 New Biome : Asgard
 One new Scion
 10+ Greenhouse Upgrades
 Many storylines!


A Challenge
As part of celebrating the Strategy Fest, we want to hold a little competition. If you manage to achieve a score of 1750+ at the end of a loop, your name will be engraved forever in the Holt for anyone to see! Good luck!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7f0f4f43464100656858206e667f601ea5cb7f34.png

In the future
While this might be the last demo for a while, we encourage you to register for the playtest if you want to be up to date with the new builds that we're sending every month to our playtesters. You can do so directly on Steam! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/250ec921b6f9622bd6edb8e42ddd01edce16367a.png

notes.title: Dev Blog : Travel Screen
notes.content:
We’ve made a big change last playtest with the implementation of the Deck building mechanics. But for that to work, you need to have the option to make modifications to your deck. That’s exactly what we included in our rework of the level select: the Travel Screen. 

Travel Screen

Each time you complete a map successfully, you will enter the travel screen. This is where you will be able to make choices on how you want to tweak your deck and prepare for the next challenge. Here are some of the events currently available in the Travel Screen:


 Draft new building cards
 Choose a building to start with in the next map
 Remove cards from your deck
 Gain an Artifact
 Add a keyword to a building card
 Add uses to a building card
 Select which biome to go to next


Of course, those events are randomized every loop!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/aa99e8dcf38c1d69f5d960c10f753a9089b608d0.gif

Ginnungagap and Time mechanic

We’re not going to go too easy on you, all these nice rewards must come at a price. That’s why we’re introducing a time mechanic in the travel screen. You will have to spend some time to move from one event to the other. The further you are from the event you wish to reach, the more time will have to be spent.

Don’t spend too much of it though because the Ginnungagap grows closer with every time spent. Swallowing locations in the travel screen, rendering them unreachable. Moreover, finding yourself in the Ginnungagap’s way will have consequences, such as adding negative modifiers or curse cards into your deck. 

This time currency is also tracked in the maps themselves! Meaning that the shorter time you spend in a level, the more time you will have to discover interest points in the travel screen. Should you hang around the map to draft more cards and explore? Or should you get out quick in the hope to find interesting rewards? That’s for you to decide.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/665737bb296904fa5cde47b49e53972f71a672f8.gif

More to come

Just like the deckbuilding changes, this is still an early implementation of the system, but it has a lot of potential for cool gameplay and narrative options. 

Should we design unique encounters with interesting choices? Creepy characters who can sell and buy Artifacts? The possibilities are endless. It is also a perfect place to learn more about the characters and the lore surrounding the game.

As always, you can sign up for the upcoming playtest that will go live on June 20th and let us know what you think of the changes in our Discord channel! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/250ec921b6f9622bd6edb8e42ddd01edce16367a.png

See you soon!

notes.title: Dev Blog : Deckbuilding
notes.content:
We constantly want to offer the best experience possible, so we’re not afraid to try new things if we think it will make our games even better. In the upcoming May playtest that’s going live next week, we’re excited to make a big change to the core gameplay with the Deckbuilding mechanic!

Why deck building?

We’ve been thinking about it for a while now. Here are the main problems we’re trying to fix with the deck building mechanics.


 Add replayability.
 Make each loop more unique.
 Take faster turns.
 Make more strategic and meaningful choices.
 Add keywords to better communicate what the cards do.
 Have more freedom in creation of unique events and buildings.
 Rely more on strategy and less on RNG to measure your success.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/d03cf0bc71895f6432346b64e33e6271b63b2719.gif

How does it work?

You will start each loop with a basic set of cards in your draw pile. Each turn, your hand goes in your discard pile, and you draw three new cards from your draw pile. When your draw pile is empty, your discard pile is shuffled and added back into your draw pile!

Reaching a population milestone will reward you with a card draft like it used to, but the card will be added to your draw pile until it is removed. This means that your deck will get bigger with each new draft, it’s up to you to decide how your deck will be constructed!

Cards can now have special keywords in their description, granting them unique behavior. Here are a few examples :


 Cornerstone : Start each map with this card in your hand.
 Retain : This card is not discarded when passing the turn.
 Exhaust : Remove the card from your deck after it is played, it will rejoin the deck in the next map.
 Curse : Card with a negative effect that stays in your deck until you find a way to remove it.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/6bafa142468e349e53d2f9eec50a265b44c5508e.gif

Future possibilities

With the Deck building mechanics, we give you much more control over how your deck is made. We can now add more unique cards, that can be very good depending on what your deck is, and let you discover the synergies between the cards, the Scions and Housing buildings!

It’s a big change, but we believe this opens up a slew of design opportunities, and we’re very excited to create new awesome features with Deck building in mind.

notes.title: Dev Blog - Threatening Difficulty
notes.content:
Before we begin, Please note that the Nidavellir Update will be available in April! You can register for the Playtest directly on the Steam Page! 

As we're moving farther into development and it becomes possible to get closer and closer to the top of Yggdrasil, it's important that the game's difficulty increases as well. We're tackling this task in many ways, but let's explore one way in this post : Threats.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/c90fee1097a6ea2bbd068a9e44cd7c5949fde06f.gif

Why did we choose to add threats into the game?
Before, a lot of negative effects in the game were simply modifiers that were applied for a certain amount of time. For example, "buildings cost are doubled for 5 turns". This works well to increase difficulty, but it's not very fun and quite easy to forget! 

Here were our goal with the new system :  

 We wanted players to be able to interact with the negative modifiers.
 We wanted players to be able to plan around the negative modifiers.
 We wanted the negative modifiers to have a physical component.


What are Threats?
Threats are dynamic objects that can spawn on the map, applying various effects. Some can be dealt with, others have to be avoided.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/cedf54cccb4f380c8da024c5429868ad76c060b7.png

How do Threats appear?
Threats can appear in two ways : 

 They can spawn when exploring, making exploration more dangerous!
 They can spawn at predetermined turns, as displayed in the timeline.


What do they do?
With the new Threat system, these negative effects are now always linked to something on the map. You might discover a Draugr camp that has a curse that double building costs, but you can now choose to deal with the Draugr quickly to get rid of the effect or maybe even ignore them! That's the case for the Storm, which simply prevents you from building on targeted hexes. It moves every turn, so you can plan around it too!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/a8a720458e1bcea79f7ca44fcb67fcdf54a6b860.png

In the Future
Threats are very flexible. With the current system, we can have threats with a huge range of effects. It's easy to imagine threats linked to specific biomes as well. Since they're now a proper system, expect other existing systems to play with them as well! Maybe an action card will allow you to get rid of a threat? Maybe a new artefact will reward you with a bonus for every defeated threat? Or maybe even reward you for every ACTIVE threat?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/4df466a02364d19b4c10392860b39dc186d1b5e5.gif

As always, if you have any comments or ideas about how to use this feature in the future, let us know on Discord! We're excited to hear what you think! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/250ec921b6f9622bd6edb8e42ddd01edce16367a.png

See you soon!

notes.title: An Eitr-esting Change!
notes.content:
Welcome to our dev update! In this post, we’ll talk about the results of our first player survey on the Yggdrasil Discord and the changes that are happening around it. Before we start, make sure you've joined our discord server if you want to participate in the next playtest. If you didn’t guess from the terrible pun in the title, the theme of the survery was Eitr and the Star Charts!

The Eitr Poll Results

When we asked about the state of the star charts in the game, the results were pretty clear. Most of you didn’t like how the start charts were in a separate UI, pausing the whole game when opened. On top of that, more than 50% of the players that answered said they often forgot to spend their Eitr! 

The good news is…. That’s pretty much what we expected and we have a plan!

Lets cut to the chase

In the next playtest, the Star Charts will be gone! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/6d5b611f2d4f7cc758c058c2d3bcfa4086431de9.png

What we designed the Star Charts for :

- Allow players to react to the randomness by choosing upgrades
- Allow players to make long term choices
- Give another use to Eitr

Unintended consequences of the Star Charts :

- The current design takes the player out of the experience.
- The current design is easily forgettable
- The current design doesn’t have enough meaningful choices

How we’re fixing it :

While the Star Charts are going away for now, everything that was obtainable inside is still present. You’ll now have more opportunities to use Eitr to acquire upgrades and customize your deck in landmarks and buildings that you’ll discover when exploring.

More Eitr events

The Observatory now has a new repeatable adventure that allows you to draft an Action Card!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/f0816c7c7796133ae1ca73c292197f08ece70399.gif

New adventures such as the Astrolabe will allow you to draft upgrades and modifiers in exchange for Eitr!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0dd49d1ab3c85f6a2bd2dbdaeca6a7c8879df68e.gif

Eitr… as power!

We want all resources to be unique, and we felt Eitr still needed an extra change to make it feel different from Supply and Might. Starting next update, Eitr will be used to power up some buildings and for map objectives!

That means you’ll have to build near the Eitr-infused wonders or use pylons to bring that power elsewhere! We hope this brings an extra layer of strategy and variety into the game and we can’t wait for you to start playing with Eitr!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0844bf770a779d17bb874c1e21dada9d06429baf.gif

March playtest and more!

If you’d like to try out these changes and help us improve the game, head over to our Discord! You’ll be able to vote on polls, talk with the devs and soon register for the March Playtest!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/250ec921b6f9622bd6edb8e42ddd01edce16367a.png

Thank you! 
See you soon!

notes.title: Discover Roots of Yggdrasil - a blend between a roguelike and a city-builder
notes.content:
We're excited to participate in this February's Next Fest and would love to hear from all of you!

Discover the enchanting world of Roots of Yggdrasil, a narrative roguelike city-building game set after Ragnarok. Build settlements and restore your Viking clan scattered across the cosmos. Can you survive the end of the world?

Experience the loop of Yggdrasil in this demo! You Start in the Holt (The Hub) and you can use the portal to start expeditions. Each expedition is a procedural challenge where you will need to build multiple settlements. The bonus you acquire will accumulate and give you new powers until you reach the top of the tree... or the void catches you!

In both cases, you'll return to the Holt with some new resources, which you can spend to unlock new features and content before trying again!

What's in it?
- Procedural Challenges!
- Two Different Biomes!
- Unlock new buildings in the Workshop!
- Unlock mechanics & scions in the Greenhouse!
- Explore up to three islands in one loop by Upgrading in the Greenhouse
- Meet the Scions of the Holt

What's NOT in it
This is just a demo, some elements of the game are not yet done!
- The story is not available yet, but there's enough world building to speculate!
- The upgrades in the Workshop and Greenhouse are limited. They will unlock with new updates to the Demo in the following weeks/months!
- The top of Yggdrasil cannot be reached yet, keep an eye out on this page as we adjust the portal to reach for more biomes and destinations!

Let us know what you think
We want your opinion! Let us know what you think about the demo and it might shape the creation of the game! You can reach out to us on the Steam forums and on Discord!

JOIN THE DISCORD

That's it for now! Have fun!

notes.title: The Demo is Live!
notes.content:
The Demo - Version 1
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/3e72b87ee5f94d253a4e176aba08cb9c03f28069.png
Experience the loop of Yggdrasil in this demo! You Start in the Holt (The Hub) and you can use the portal to start expeditions. Each expedition is a procedural challenge where you will need to build multiple settlements. The bonus you acquire will accumulate and give you new powers until you reach the top of the tree... or the void catches you!

In both cases, you'll return to the Holt with some new resources, which you can spend to unlock new features and content before trying again!

What's in it?
- Procedural Challenges!
- Two Different Biomes!
- Unlock new buildings in the Workshop!
- Unlock mechanics & scions in the Greenhouse!
- Explore up to three islands in one loop by Upgrading in the Greenhouse
- Meet the Scions of the Holt

What's NOT in it
This is just a demo, some elements of the game are not yet done!
- The story is not available yet, but there's enough world building to speculate!
- The upgrades in the Workshop and Greenhouse are limited. They will unlock with new updates to the Demo in the following weeks/months!
- The top of Yggdrasil cannot be reached yet, keep an eye out on this page as we adjust the portal to reach for more biomes and destinations!

Let us know what you think
We want your opinion! Let us know what you think about the demo and it might shape the creation of the game! You can reach out to us on the Steam forums and on Discord!

JOIN THE DISCORD

That's it for now! Have fun!

notes.title: Building Yggdrasil - 2022 Recap
notes.content:
Hello everyone! For our first update of the year, let's recap what's happened since the last update back in September! Oh, and expect more regular updates from now on too!

Public Demo
The Roots of Yggdrasil team is hard at work preparing a demo that you will soon be able to play! The demo will throw you directly into the action, letting you experience the citybuilding and roguelike elements! And it all starts with the Holt!

The Holt (Hub)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/2c4c4965189a6722965c92334aed1cad90973592.png
This is where you'll return after every loop and visit the scions that are helping you on your quest. Each of them has their own stories and ways to help you on your journey. 

Visit Lif at the Greenhouse to gain new permanent abilities! Or visit Thrasir at the Workshop to unlock new buildings for your future expeditions!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/40746392baeb2344f5376752db98abea763099eb.png

The Star Charts
Another feature that we will preview in the upcoming demo is Star Charts. By spending the Eitr that you gather when creating your villages, you'll be able to research upgrades that will help you in your current run. To embrace the roguelike element, all star charts are procedural, so you'll have to adapt every game!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0cc84b7020921bac6b4a2c041046f6d5026e56f4.png

Biomes
The last sneak peek we'll share today are the biomes. We've made a lot of progress and are finally able to showcase the first new biome. Once the beautiful coast of Midgard, these lands are now poisoned by the venom of Jormungandr, the World Serpent, who was slain here by Thor. Now called the Venom Wastes, these hostile lands have become inhospitable. You'll still need to establish settlements here if you wish to power up the portals and keep your journey going!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/ba5ff7ecdd48829909650e70c21074ed61354960.png

That's it!
Keep an eye out for more news soon! We can't wait to share the upcoming demo with you!
